mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, so it is never turned off for local or dev work. This sits alongside the recorded decision to use HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so there is no carve-out that would allow unverified or plain-HTTP connections in development.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
